_comment: Reference persona for the bundled example brand. Copy to brand/personas/<id>.json
(gitignored) and edit — persona.py prefers a live persona and falls back to here.
Every field below is fictional. A persona names a PUBLIC identity, so treat a real one
the way you treat a credential: keep it out of a repo you intend to publish.

⚠️ `archetype` is a CLOSED enum in persona.schema.json and its values are one vertical's roles (vet / dog_mom / groomer). 'creator' is the generic one. If your persona is not a creator, widen the enum in the schema — adding values is backwards-compatible.
backstory: Fictional reference persona for Acme Supply Co. A working tradesperson who reviews tools honestly, explains the boring maintenance nobody films, and answers beginner questions without condescension.

visual_identity.look: Mid-30s, short dark hair, light stubble, small scar on the left hand. Consistent across every render — this string is the identity contract.

disclosure: AI-assisted creator account, in partnership with Acme Supply Co.
